articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Zoom Anthropic Stake Reframes Growth Outlook And Valuation Story. Zoom Communications (NasdaqGS:ZM) is drawing attention for its early investment in Anthropic, a leading generative AI company. Analysts are now calling this AI stake a hidden gem that may be more valuable to Zoom than previously appreciated. The development is feeding a broader discussion about how Anthropic could influence Zoom’s product roadmap and growth direction. For investors tracking Zoom at a current share price of $92.1, this Anthropic position adds another layer to the story... Related tickers mentioned: ANTH.PVT.
